recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. If a modern differential rendering problem with slicing remains, handle it in IG Publisher/kindling tooling rather than changing current FHIR specification source.
issue_request: FHIR-3969 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request reporting that coding slicing by system from the spreadsheet was not displayed in the differential view for the DAF DiagnosticReport profile; the final Jira comment says the display was now present and notes that the linked profile did not have slices.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit was found. The issue appears to have been applied as a historical publisher/rendering behavior change rather than a durable authored FHIR-core source change in this checkout.
additional_context: The referenced DAF DiagnosticReport artifact is not active current-build FHIR-core source: the DAF IG entry in source/igs.xml is commented out and source/fhir.ini has no active daf-diagnosticreport entry. The current build uses the external kindling dependency to run org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher, and this checkout contains no Java publisher implementation. The later related FHIR-17241 sliced-element display issue is already audited on the combined branch as external-repo.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no source changes.
